# v0.3.1

- A maintenance release: nothing in the app itself changes. It tightens the checks that run before a release (the version, the tags, these notes, and that the app is built for Apple Silicon) and brings the documentation up to date.
- It is also the first version offered through **Check for Updates…**: if you have 0.3.0, this release is there to try the in-app update with. Choose **Install Update** when the app shows it.
- After the update, macOS may ask again whether the app may control Finder (and reach your folders): the app is ad-hoc signed, so each version counts as a new app to macOS. Allow it once more.
